ruleDefinitions.name: Rebuild Performance Counter Values Via Lodctr.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of "lodctr.exe" to rebuild the performance counter registry values. This can be abused by attackers by providing a malicious config file to overwrite performance counter configuration to confuse and evade monitoring and security solutions.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\lodctr\\\.exe$") AND process_original_file_name = "LODCTR\.EXE") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-r.*"))
